subject: Judge E: DAG-only injected context at claim (drop RAG-fill tier; keep search_knowledge as explicit tool)
description:
When a worker claims a task, its AUTO-INJECTED context is the judged DAG neighborhood ONLY — no retrieval-time RAG-fill tier. Safe BECAUSE tasks A–D guarantee the DAG is complete-and-judged at claim time (eager judgment + ready-gate remove the staleness boundary). Part of the eager-judgment-lifecycle redesign.

DESIGN:
1. Collapse the two-tier retrieval at claim/injection: drop the RAG-fill tier; inject only the task's judged context_deps (the DAG neighborhood). The DAG is now the compiled/judged RAG, so re-running raw RAG at consumption only adds unjudged noise.
2. KEEP search_knowledge as an EXPLICIT agent tool (fork 3 default — TUNABLE): only the AUTO-injected context is DAG-only; a worker that reasons it needs out-of-neighborhood info can still call search_knowledge deliberately. Do NOT remove that tool — that would kill discovery of anything not pre-wired.
3. Document the invariant: DAG-only auto-context is correct ONLY under the ready-gate guarantee (task D). If the gate is bypassed/disabled, fall back to two-tier.

TEST: a claimed task's injected context contains only judged DAG edges (no rag-tier entries); search_knowledge still callable and returns results; an unjudged-flagged task (timeout fallback) still gets its (flagged) context.

GUARDRAIL: blocked by D — DAG-only is only safe once the ready-gate guarantees a complete judged DAG.

summary: Judge E (DAG-only injected claim context) implemented + committed. The claim-time consult — search_knowledge with task_key → GET /search tiered path (routes/graph.js) — now injects the JUDGED DAG neighborhood ONLY for a fully-judged task: dagOnly = !taskNode.provisional; results = dagOnly ? [...dagNotes] : [...dagNotes, ...ragResults].slice(...). The retrieval-time RAG-fill tier is dropped from the auto-injected bundle. Weight-0/judged:false edges were already excluded from context_deps by the daemon projection (kept). SAFE under Judge D's judging→ready gate (DAG complete-and-judged at claim time). INVARIANT GUARD: a provisional task (D's timeout fallback) KEEPS the RAG-fill — never DAG-only-blind; documented in code comments at both edit sites. search_knowledge unchanged as an explicit tool (lib/mcp-core.js untouched): ungated/no-task_key lookups and provisional tasks still get the full RAG bundle. Files: routes/graph.js (+21/-2). New test/dag-only-claim-context.test.js (13 assertions: pure layer for the dagOnly=!provisional decision incl. provisional-keeps-RAG + empty-neighbors; HTTP layer for fully-judged DAG-only + explicit-lookup unchanged — provisional is pure-substrate because graph-store edge serialization drops judged:false on disk reload, same constraint judging-gate.test.js hit). Full suite 99/110; the 11 failures are the SAME pre-existing daemon-spawn sandbox failures as HEAD baseline (98/109, identical set) — git-stash confirmed, zero new failures. routes/classify.js untouched. WORKTREE: /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator/worktrees/62dae274979b8432/091a4bf1-b671-4ff9-854d-993775faa5ee-18 ; BRANCH: orch/attempt/091a4bf1-b671-4ff9-854d-993775faa5ee-18 ; commit 28cad66. CLAIM PATH: standard MCP start_task rejected the dispatcher session (known gap) — used the sanctioned fallback: POST /agent/start → POST /overlay/claim-session (needs task_key+session_id, not key) → start_task (ok). DAEMON RESTART REQUIRED to go live (route change) — NOT restarted (gated).
